regulatory-affairs-specialists.en: Coordinate, prepare, or review regulatory submissions for domestic or international projects.

remote-sensing-scientists-and-technologi.zh: 用统计、图像分析或地理信息工具分析航空和卫星等遥感数据。
remote-sensing-scientists-and-technologi.en: Analyze remote-sensing data from aircraft, satellites, or ground systems using statistical, imaging, or GIS software.

remote-sensing-technicians.zh: 核查遥感图像数据的完整性和准确性。
remote-sensing-technicians.en: Check remote-sensing imagery data for completeness and accuracy.

residential-advisors.zh: 监督、培训和评估学生宿舍工作人员。
residential-advisors.en: Supervise, train, and evaluate residence hall staff.

retail-loss-prevention-specialists.zh: 实施或监督减少商品或财务损失的流程。
retail-loss-prevention-specialists.en: Implement or monitor processes that reduce property or financial losses.

robotics-engineers.zh: 搭建、配置或测试机器人及其应用。
robotics-engineers.en: Build, configure, or test robots and robotic applications.

robotics-technicians.zh: 维修机器人及外围设备，更换有故障的传感器或控制器等零件。
robotics-technicians.en: Repair robots and peripheral equipment by replacing faulty parts such as sensors or controllers.

school-bus-monitors.zh: 协助有残障或其他支持需要的儿童上下校车。
school-bus-monitors.en: Help children with disabilities or other support needs board and exit school buses.

school-psychologists.zh: 解读测评结果，并为教师、管理人员和家长准备心理评估报告。
school-psychologists.en: Interpret assessment results and prepare psychological reports for teachers, administrators, and parents.

search-marketing-strategists.zh: 跟踪并汇报搜索营销活动，为营销管理人员提供分析。
search-marketing-strategists.en: Track and report search activity and provide analysis to marketing leaders.

security-management-specialists.zh: 评估实体安全威胁的性质及程度，确定问题范围。
security-management-specialists.en: Assess the nature and severity of physical security threats to define the scope of the problem.

shampooers.zh: 清洗和护理顾客的头发和头皮，去除多余油脂。
shampooers.en: Wash and condition clients’ hair and scalp.

shoe-and-leather-workers-and-repairers.zh: 按照规格制作、装饰或修理皮革制品。
shoe-and-leather-workers-and-repairers.en: Make, decorate, or repair leather products to specifications.

social-and-community-service-managers.zh: 评估员工和志愿者的工作，核对服务质量与资源使用。
social-and-community-service-managers.en: Evaluate staff and volunteer work for program quality and effective use of resources.

solar-energy-installation-managers.zh: 规划和协调光伏或太阳能热系统安装，确保符合规范。
solar-energy-installation-managers.en: Plan and coordinate solar installations to meet applicable codes.

solar-energy-systems-engineers.zh: 设计住宅或商业建筑使用的光伏或太阳能热系统。
solar-energy-systems-engineers.en: Design or coordinate the design of photovoltaic or solar thermal systems for buildings.

sound-engineering-technicians.zh: 在录音过程中使用调音台控制音量与音质。
sound-engineering-technicians.en: Use a mixing console to control volume and sound quality during recording.

spa-managers.zh: 协调场地日程，提高设施利用率。
spa-managers.en: Coordinate facility schedules to make efficient use of space.

speech-language-pathologists.zh: 跟踪患者进展，并按需要调整言语或语言治疗。
speech-language-pathologists.en: Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment as needed.

speech-language-pathology-assistants.zh: 记录服务对象实现既定治疗目标的进展。
speech-language-pathology-assistants.en: Document clients’ progress toward established treatment goals.

sports-medicine-physicians.zh: 诊断或治疗肌肉骨骼系统问题。

stationary-engineers-and-boiler-operator.zh: 操作锅炉和泵等辅助设备，维持蒸汽或热力供应。
stationary-engineers-and-boiler-operator.en: Operate boilers and auxiliary equipment such as pumps to maintain steam or heat supply.

stockers-and-order-fillers.zh: 盘点和检查商品，确定需要补货或重新订购的品项。
stockers-and-order-fillers.en: Check inventory to identify items that need replenishment or reordering.

stone-cutters-and-carvers-manufacturing.zh: 测量切割或雕刻的深度和尺寸，核对图纸或样模要求。
stone-cutters-and-carvers-manufacturing.en: Measure cuts or carvings against plans or models.

surgical-assistants.zh: 在手术过程中监督和维持无菌操作。
surgical-assistants.en: Monitor and maintain aseptic technique throughout surgery.

surgical-technologists.zh: 在手术前后清点纱布、针具和器械。
surgical-technologists.en: Count sponges, needles, and instruments before and after surgery.

surveying-and-mapping-technicians.zh: 把定位数据、现场笔记或测量报告录入地理信息系统，生成地图或图纸。
surveying-and-mapping-technicians.en: Enter positioning data, field notes, or survey reports into GIS to produce maps and drawings.

surveyors.zh: 依据契据和产权文件开展测量，确定土地的法定边界。
surveyors.en: Conduct surveys using deeds and titles to establish legal property boundaries.

sustainability-specialists.zh: 跟踪能耗、资源使用、废弃物和回收等可持续指标。
sustainability-specialists.en: Track indicators such as energy use, resource use, waste, and recycling.

team-assemblers.zh: 查阅作业单和图纸，确认装配工作符合规格。
team-assemblers.en: Check work orders and blueprints to ensure the work meets specifications.

telecommunications-engineering-specialis.zh: 记录电信设备的技术规格和操作标准。
telecommunications-engineering-specialis.en: Document technical specifications and operating standards for telecommunications equipment.

telemarketers.zh: 向电话客户讲解产品、服务及价格，并回答问题。
telemarketers.en: Explain products, services, or prices by phone and answer questions.

telephone-operators.zh: 操作电话交换系统，接通本地或长途等电话。
telephone-operators.en: Operate telephone switchboards to connect calls, including local or long-distance calls.

traffic-technicians.zh: 评估道路照明、标志和标线的可见性对交通的影响。
traffic-technicians.en: Study how lighting and the visibility of signs and markings affect traffic conditions.

transportation-engineers.zh: 为公路、桥梁、通勤铁路等交通设施编制工程设计方案。
transportation-engineers.en: Prepare engineering plans for transportation facilities such as roads, bridges, and commuter rail.

transportation-planners.zh: 在公共会议上解释交通规划提案，并听取受影响群体的反馈。
transportation-planners.en: Explain transportation proposals at public meetings and gather feedback from affected groups.

travel-guides.zh: 根据交通路线和目的地情况规划行程。
travel-guides.en: Plan tour itineraries using knowledge of routes and destinations.

urban-and-regional-planners.zh: 拟订或管理土地利用、分区及公共设施等规划政策。
urban-and-regional-planners.en: Develop or administer plans and policies for land use, zoning, and public facilities.

urologists.zh: 开具并解读诊断检查，为评估泌尿系统问题提供依据。
urologists.en: Order and interpret diagnostic tests to evaluate urological conditions.

validation-engineers.zh: 分析验证测试数据，判断系统或流程是否达标，或定位生产问题的原因。
validation-engineers.en: Analyze validation test data to check whether systems or processes meet criteria or to find the cause of production problems.

veterinary-assistants-and-laboratory-ani.zh: 观察动物术后恢复情况，并把异常变化报告给兽医。
veterinary-assistants-and-laboratory-ani.en: Monitor animals recovering from surgery and alert the veterinarian to unusual changes.

veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.zh: 检测动物血液、尿液或粪便样本，为诊疗提供依据。
veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.en: Run laboratory tests on animal blood, urine, or fecal samples to assist diagnosis and treatment.

water-resource-specialists.zh: 建立或运行水文、水力或水质模型。
water-resource-specialists.en: Perform hydrologic, hydraulic, or water quality modeling.

water-wastewater-engineers.zh: 设计生活或工业给水与污水处理设施。
water-wastewater-engineers.en: Design water or wastewater treatment facilities for domestic or industrial use.

web-administrators.zh: 确定或记录网站备份及恢复计划。
web-administrators.en: Identify or document website backup and recovery plans.

wind-energy-engineers.zh: 绘制或更新风电场布局图和工程示意图。
wind-energy-engineers.en: Create or maintain wind farm layouts and engineering schematics.

wind-energy-operations-managers.zh: 记录风电场运行表现、停机事件和零部件使用情况。
wind-energy-operations-managers.en: Track wind site performance, downtime events, and parts usage.

wind-turbine-service-technicians.zh: 诊断风力涡轮机发电设备或控制系统的故障。
wind-turbine-service-technicians.en: Diagnose faults in wind turbine generators or control systems.
